title: Sprint Plan — v0.1.3
sprint_goal: Refactor architecture (ARCH-001), maps, current functionality enhancements

builds.detail: Create folder structure, ChatOrchestrator pass-through, ToolRouter with allowlist (kills globals().get — F-05). App runs unchanged.

builds.task: Maps: Provider search results on map
builds.detail: Add map component to frontend. Providers already have lat/lng from NPI data. Display results on interactive map alongside bullet list.
Add burns, drowning, trauma, diabetic emergency, childbirth keywords. Create brain/machine_artifacts/emergency_keywords.json.
Move find_providers() to ProviderSearchService. Introduce FindCareFacade. Update ToolRouter. Validate pattern.
Move find_specialty_codes() to SpecialtyService. Wire through FindCareFacade.

builds.task: F-10: Raise provider search result cap to 25
builds.detail: Configurable limit in ProviderSearchService (new class). Default 25.
Move to EvaluateCareQuality domain. Introduce EvaluateCareFacade. Facade-to-facade for travel calculations.
SafetyService, EmergencyDetector, ConsentService, LeadService, UnknownQuestionService, AboutService, URLGuardian relocation.
Define input/output schemas for all 9 tools. Validation layer in ToolRouter.
Remove monolith. app.py + HostChatAdapter is the entry point. Zero business logic in HuggingFace surface.
Run all unit tests, integration tests, GPT-5.3 SIT on refactored code. Baseline comparison against pre-refactor outputs.
Merge dev to qa. Deploy to qa HF Space + qa Cloudflare. Smoke test.
Boss tests maps, provider search, clinical trials, safety, consent on QA environment.
Address Boss feedback from QA testing.
Merge qa to main. Deploy. Boss sign-off required (GOV-007).

enhancements_included.title: Interactive map for provider search results

deliverables.task: Performance tuning — end-to-end response time optimization
deliverables.detail: Profile and optimize: startup time (FIPS load 2x, ~120s), provider search latency (BUG-PERF-001, 87s VA), embedding call overhead, MongoDB query patterns, cold start reduction.

deferred_to_next_sprint: F-06: Durable Functions status URL auth (Pipeline concern, not chat refactor)
F-08: All-state coverage (pipeline run, not code change)
F-13: Lock architecture docs (Boss decision on access gate)
risks: Phase 4-5 (Thursday) is the highest risk day — extracting two domains + shared services. If behind, push Phase 5 to Friday.
Maps depends on frontend map library selection (Leaflet vs Google Maps vs Mapbox). Decision needed Tuesday morning.
Pydantic phase may surface schema mismatches between what Claude sends and what tools expect. Budget extra time.
